gt_provenance.details: Steering-effect component uses LLM-judge (GPT-5.4) proxy annotations. Direction stability (split-half cosine, cos-to-reference) is purely geometric — no GT needed there.

score_normalization.details: ratio_to_large_pool normalizes by reference delta (steering effect at n_pairs=reference), which is itself model-output derived. Geometric stability metrics (cosines) are fine.

result_existence.details: split-half cos 0.588 at n=25 consistent with seed-average from M2 sweep. cos-to-reference 0.944 consistent. Other behaviours listed as untestable and confirmed by n_pos caps.

dead_code.details: All M2 output fields (split_half_cos, cos_to_reference, steered_rate, delta_rate, ratio_to_large_pool) present in results file.

scope.details: Limitations disclosed: only uncertainty testable (n_pos=28), 30-task subset (plan: 50), n_pairs grid truncated by corpus size. Verdict labeled partial/under-power.
